journey.name: activity explorer resolves translated plurals
journey.description: Requires an onboarded disposable regtest wallet with a native on-chain activity whose transaction details have one input and two outputs. Record its transaction ID and the currently selected app language before starting. This checks the iOS plural-formatting fix; Android already formats these translations with ICU. It changes only the app language and restores it at the end. Restart after each language change as the language alert requests.

actions.action: From Home, open the menu (id "HeaderMenu") and Settings (id "DrawerSettings"), open Language (id "LanguageSettings"), and record the currently selected language
Tap Polish, dismiss the Language Changed alert with OK, then terminate and relaunch Bitkit with the simulator tools and unlock if needed
Open the recorded on-chain transaction from Activity and tap its transaction details button (id "ActivityTxDetails")
Wait for transaction details to load and verify the transaction ID (id "TXID") matches the recorded transaction
Verify the input heading is WEJŚCIE and the output heading is WYJŚCIA (2), with no literal braces, plural keywords, or hash placeholders
Return to Settings and Language (id "LanguageSettings"), select French, dismiss the alert with OK, then terminate and relaunch Bitkit and unlock if needed
Open the same transaction's details (id "ActivityTxDetails") and verify its headings are ENTRÉE and SORTIES (2), with no raw plural template
Return to Settings and Language (id "LanguageSettings"), select English, dismiss the alert with OK, then terminate and relaunch Bitkit and unlock if needed
Open the same transaction's details (id "ActivityTxDetails") and verify its headings are INPUT and OUTPUTS (2)
Return to Settings and Language (id "LanguageSettings"), restore the original language, dismiss any language alert, and restart Bitkit if the language changed
